body:
The Four Seasons: 1. The four seasons (how the weather changes over the year). 2. They change color and fall down. 3. Cold; in some places it snows. 4. Rain (and warmer weather). 5. Fall.
My Favorite Season: any season is right. The drawing shows weather that fits that season, and the reason uses the weather or what the student does in it ("I like winter because I can play in the snow.").
Fall Week, Winter Week: 1. 3 sunny days. 2. 3 snowy days. 3. The fall week (3 is more than 1). 4. It got colder: fewer sunny days and some snowy days.
Seasons Check: 1. Winter. 2. Fall. 3. Spring. 4. Spring. 5. Drawing shows a sunny, warm day and summer clothes such as shorts, a sun hat or sandals.
Scoring tip: where winters are mild, accept "rainy" or "cool" as winter weather if it matches your chart. A favorite season with no reason is Getting there on "I told why, using the weather".
title: Answer key: Four Seasons
